manifest.fit_rule: For forecast origin t and horizon h, every training origin s must satisfy s+h<=t. Median imputation and standardization are fitted only on allowed training rows.

derived: WALCL-WTREGEN-1000*RRPONTSYD net liquidity; positive net-liquidity log changes over 13w/52w
macro_feature_classification.growth_transform: log(value) difference over 13 and 52 weekly origins; requires positive value

source_exclusions.BAMLH0A0HYM2: Excluded before any macro model metrics were observed because FRED/ICE notes state that starting April 2026 the series only includes 3 years of observations; the live ALFRED request returned HTTP 400 for the required 2018+ PIT history.
source_exclusions.SP500: Excluded before any macro model metrics were observed because FRED states that FRED and associated services include only 10 years of daily S&P history; live ALFRED PIT requests for the required 2018 vintage history returned HTTP 400 even with a bounded 400-day observation lookback. NASDAQCOM remains as the pre-specified equity-risk proxy.

manifest.macro_vintage_rule: At forecast origin t, macro values must come from ALFRED vintage t (or latest state returned for that exact vintage date); no value with available_at > t.
manifest.model_selection_rule: No hyperparameter search. Compare fixed price-only Ridge against fixed price+macro Ridge. Do not change feature set or alpha based on 2024-2025 results.
manifest.probability_note: P(up) is a baseline normal approximation from predicted log return and training-target dispersion, not a calibrated posterior.
manifest.weekly_origin_anchor: 2018-01-01 every 7 days; current latest BTC date appended for prospective forecast
